fullTestModelReview.formatCounterpart: No direct Segment 105/119 numeric/fixed-length rule found in the 1,343-record Test model.
fullTestModelReview.allowedValuesCounterpart: A broader Appendix L authored rule exists but is scoped to Segments 100/111, not these Segment 105/119 chains.
fullTestModelReview.optionalContext: Currency Code may be optional for these message types; if omitted in a Transaction Request, ATL105 states the value defaults to 840. Do not treat an empty-string observation as proof of field omission or as a presence failure.

formatCases.assessment: The four values are observed in the correct candidate field scope. The format-only boundary value 000 is three numeric digits; currency-code validity is a separate rule. Empty string is not proof of omitted field.
